title: A revert commit with no Red-run trailer is caught when it is written or pushed, not at lane lint
why: Lane notes-fix-page (session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8): revert 8c05e5bc7 on #1581 went out with no Red-run trailer; lint/check_red_run.py caught it only at lane lint after the hand-off, so the fix took two replacement PRs (#2139, #2140).
note: Filed 10:29 CST Nov 8 from that lane. First check whether a commit-msg or pre-push hook already runs it and was skipped by plumbing (the lane lands with git commit-tree and a push of a sha to refs/heads). Maybe covered by lane-lint-before-push (doing), which runs fast lane-lint checks before a push: ask that lane before building.
